title: Scan Repair for Foundation Models: code for 'Fix What the Model Leaves Behind: Fast Subgroup Repair for Tree Ensembles and Tabular Foundation Models' (AccML 2027)
description: Structured Scan Repair: fast, interpretable, held-out-validated subgroup repair for frozen tabular classifiers (TabPFN-2.5, TabICLv2, XGBoost, CatBoost), with every experiment and the scripts that rebuild every table, figure and number of the AccML 2027 paper. Saved logits and results are archived separately (scan-repair-foundation-models-artifacts).
